_: C17 — the pose description for every movement that has a detail page.
One line per movement, naming the body position precisely enough that an
illustration is unmistakably THAT movement and not a near neighbour. These
are the part a generator cannot infer: 'Goblet squat' and 'Split squat' are
both squats, and only the described position tells them apart.
Written from each movement's own cues in exercises.ts and
recovery-library.ts, so the drawing and the coaching agree. `view` is the
camera angle that makes the movement readable — a side view of a lateral

Dumbbell floor press.pose: lying on the back on the floor, knees bent and feet flat, pressing two dumbbells straight up from chest height, upper arms at roughly 45 degrees to the ribs, elbows just off the floor at the bottom

Push-up.pose: front-support position, one straight line from head to heels, hands under the shoulders, chest lowered to just above the floor, glutes braced so the hips neither sag nor pike

Incline push-up.pose: push-up position with both hands on the edge of a waist-height kitchen counter, body in one straight line at roughly 45 degrees to the floor, chest travelling to the counter edge

Dumbbell squeeze press.pose: lying on the back, two dumbbells pressed hard together end to end above the chest, palms facing each other, arms extending straight up while the bells stay touching

One-arm dumbbell row.pose: one knee and the same-side hand braced on a flat bench, back flat and level like a tabletop, opposite hand pulling a dumbbell up to the hip, no twist through the torso

Bent-over dumbbell row.pose: standing, hips hinged back to a shallow 30 to 45 degrees, back flat, chest proud, both elbows pulling dumbbells up past the ribs

Superman hold.pose: lying face down on the floor, arms reaching long in front, chest and thighs lifted only a few centimetres clear, neck neutral with the gaze at the floor

Prone Y-raise.pose: lying face down, arms reaching out and up in a wide Y shape with thumbs turned to the ceiling, lifting a small distance from the shoulder blades

Goblet squat.pose: standing, one dumbbell held vertically tight against the chest in both hands, squatting down between the heels with the torso upright and the knees tracking over the toes

Dumbbell Romanian deadlift.pose: standing tall, knees soft, hips pushed back so the torso hinges forward, dumbbells sliding down the front of the thighs, back flat throughout

Split squat.pose: long split stance, torso tall and vertical, back knee dropping straight down toward the floor, front heel planted flat, one hand resting on a chair back for balance

Glute bridge.pose: lying on the back, heels drawn close to the hips, hips driven up to a straight line from knee to shoulder, ribs down with no arch in the low back

Seated dumbbell press.pose: seated upright on a bench with back support, dumbbells pressing overhead, forearms vertical throughout, ribs down with no back arch

Lateral raise.pose: standing, dumbbells lifting out to the sides led by the elbows, stopping level with the shoulders, a slight forward tilt of the wrists

Pike push-up.pose: hands and feet on the floor with hips lifted high into an inverted V, head travelling down toward the floor between the hands, elbows at 45 degrees

Dumbbell front raise.pose: standing, one dumbbell raised straight out in front to eye height with a strict arm and no body swing, the other arm resting at the side

Dumbbell curl.pose: standing tall, elbows pinned against the ribs, dumbbells curling up to the shoulders with no hip swing

Overhead triceps extension.pose: standing, both hands cupping one dumbbell overhead, elbows pointing forward and staying narrow, the bell lowering behind the head

Chair dip.pose: hands on the front edge of a sturdy chair behind the body, feet out in front, elbows pointing straight back, a shallow dip with the shoulders held down away from the ears

Hammer curl.pose: standing, dumbbells curling with a neutral grip, thumbs up throughout, elbows fixed at the sides

Dead bug.pose: lying on the back, arms reaching straight up at the ceiling and knees stacked over the hips at 90 degrees, one arm and the opposite leg reaching away toward the floor while the low back stays pressed down

Side plank.pose: on one side supported on the forearm, elbow directly under the shoulder, hips lifted so the body makes one straight line, knees down as the easier version

Bird dog.pose: on hands and knees, back flat enough to balance a cup on, one arm and the opposite leg reaching long and level rather than high

Suitcase carry.pose: walking tall with one heavy dumbbell hanging at one side, shoulders level and no lean toward or away from the load

Dumbbell thruster.pose: two-panel sequence: squatting with dumbbells racked at the shoulders, then standing and pressing them overhead in one fluid motion

Reverse lunge + curl.pose: stepping one foot backwards into a lunge with a tall torso, curling the dumbbells during the stand back up

Step-up.pose: stepping onto a low box with the whole foot planted, driving up through the heel, the trailing leg still extended behind

Inchworm walk-out.pose: three-panel sequence: standing folded with soft knees and hands on the floor, hands walking out, ending in a straight plank

Heel drop.pose: standing tall with one hand on a kitchen counter, rising onto the toes then dropping the heels sharply back to the floor through straight-ish legs

Stamping march.pose: marching on the spot, one knee lifted to a comfortable low height, the other foot stamping down flat through the whole foot

Cat–cow.pose: two-panel sequence on hands and knees: the spine rounded up toward the ceiling, then gently arched with the chest opening, the head following the spine rather than leading

Quadruped rock-back.pose: on hands and knees, hips drifting back toward the heels while the spine stays perfectly flat and level, stopping before the low back would round

Hip circles.pose: standing on one leg with both hands on a wall for balance, the lifted knee drawing a slow circle in the air

World's greatest stretch.pose: deep lunge with the front foot flat and the back leg straight, the same-side hand on the floor inside the front foot, the other arm reaching up to the ceiling with the chest rotating open

Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch.pose: half-kneeling with the back knee on a cushion and the front foot flat, the tailbone tucked under, easing the hips forward a small distance

Chin tuck.pose: head sliding straight back over the shoulders to make a double chin, no nodding and no tilt, jaw staying level

Thoracic rotation.pose: seated or standing with hands behind the head, the ribcage turning to one side while the hips stay square to the front

Wall angel.pose: back flat against a wall, arms in a goalpost shape sliding up and down with wrists and elbows staying in contact, ribs down with no arch

Wrist and finger opener.pose: kneeling with palms flat on the floor and fingers pointing back toward the knees, easing the body weight gently forward

Standing hamstring reach.pose: standing with soft knees, hinging forward from the hips with a flat back, hands reaching toward the shins rather than the floor

Supine hamstring stretch.pose: lying on the back with a towel looped around one foot, that leg drawn up with a straight-ish knee, the other leg long and flat on the floor

Doorway chest stretch.pose: standing in a doorway with one forearm flat on the frame, elbow level with the shoulder, stepping through until the chest opens

Child's pose.pose: kneeling with the knees wide and hips settled back toward the heels, arms reaching long on the floor in front, forehead resting down, a cushion under the hips

Figure-4 stretch.pose: lying on the back with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee making a figure four, both hands reaching through to draw the supporting thigh toward the chest

Supine twist.pose: lying on the back with both knees falling together to one side onto a cushion, both shoulders staying flat on the floor, head turned the other way

Legs up the wall.pose: lying on the back with the hips close to a wall and both legs resting straight up it, arms out wide with palms up, completely still

Box breathing.pose: seated upright and relaxed, one hand resting on the belly, eyes closed, with four thin arrows drawn in a square around the figure to show in, hold, out, hold

90/90 breathing.pose: lying on the back with both calves resting on a chair seat, knees and hips at right angles, low back settled toward the floor, one hand on the ribs

Deep belly breathing.pose: seated with one hand on the belly and one on the chest, the belly hand rising first, the mouth pursed on the way out

Neck drainage strokes.pose: seated, flat fingers of one hand stroking gently downward along the side of the neck toward the collarbone, with a small arrow showing the downward direction

Armpit pump.pose: standing with both arms raising out to the sides and lowering in slow arcs, letting the armpits open and close, with faint motion arcs

Abdominal circles.pose: lying or seated with one flat palm drawing a slow clockwise circle on the belly, an arrow tracing the clockwise path

Ankle pumps and calf strokes.pose: seated with one leg supported, the foot pointing and flexing, then both hands stroking upward along the calf toward the knee, with an upward arrow
